svg.text: The AI block of simp-agent — one complete picture
Blocks = what happens. Cards on the arrows = the data passed between steps. Purple tags = book chapter + code.
← COMING BACK — the answer, piece by piece
— carried by the last event (done / error)
what went wrong; fatal/budget/policy = no retry
Unknown model, no API key, network error → it becomes an error {message} event. Ch04 · Ch15 retry
The Agent decides what next (looks at stop_reason) → Part 2
tool_use → run each ToolCall → make a ToolResultMessage → add both to Context.messages → call stream() again (back to ①)
stop → the turn is over; show the text to the user
length / error / aborted → stop, retry, or compact the chat (Ch15, Ch16, Ch17)
